cards.title: Identity & Lifecycle Ownership
items: Runtime allocates opaque effectId (7G) after revalidating 7B semantics; effectId distinct from cause/correlation/sourceInstance
Runtime owns lifecycle: sealing/draining, cancellation and stale-result fencing, not Presentation or Lumi
Behavior Policy owns presentation lifecycle: TTL 650-1000ms, visibility, epoch correlation, not Runtime execution

cards.title: Admission & Fencing
items: 7I: pure policy veto (policyAllowsEmbodiedEffect) → POLICY_DENIED; no device detail in Runtime
Behavior Policy: derived P0>P1>P2>P3 + correlation turn/session epoch + capability live2d/connectivity + TTL → drop if stale
7H: pure stale-callback fence (currentEffectId vs callbackEffectId) → STALE dropped; CompanionBus dedup + correlation drops duplicates

cards.title: Rejection & No Authority Leak
items: Malformed: Harness MALFORMED / generation supervision TRUNCATED/OVER_BUDGET/REPETITION → bounded diagnostic, no exec
Transport: WS ActiveTrace cap 256 + oldestTerminal eviction + unsupported type → runtime.error; CompanionBus knownKinds/exactKeys/role loopback → drop; Lumi 404 if asset missing
Timeout/Cancel: AbortSignal → CANCELLED → normalized failure; Presentation/Lumi outcome is observe-only, never admits Runtime
